svg.title: GainSec — Project Constellation turntable
svg.desc: Isometric turntable of GainSec's Project Constellation: 5 category towers (60 projects) on a 3×3 grid, height = projects per category, each tower stacked from its subcategories in README order with segment height = projects per subcategory, one hue family per category, one world-fixed light, Blender-coloured XYZ gizmo; outlined: the subcategory with the most recent push (Offensive Tooling / Wireless + Device Tooling). Vulnerability / Security Research 19 (Connected Public Safety and Anti-Crime Technology 13; Software 2; Automotive + V2X Security 2; Hardware + Embedded Security 1; Research Companion Material 1). Technical Walkthroughs 5 (Tutorials + Build Guides 3; Lectures + Educational Material 1; Workflow Guides 1). Offensive Tooling 16 (Fuzzing + Adversarial Testing 1; Reconnaissance + Enumeration 1; OSINT 4; Assessment Workflow 5; Wireless + Device Tooling 2; Payload + Bypass Research 1; Legacy Tooling 2). Open / Public Source Projects 19 (Hardware + Embedded 3; RF + Wireless 2; LLM / ML / AI / Agents 10; Applications + Utilities 3; Data + Visualization 1). Everything Else 1 (Experiments 1).
